title: Game AI Unleashed: From Finite State Machines to Machine Learning
description: Chronicles AI's evolution in gaming, from simple state machines to advanced machine learning, enhancing gameplay and immersion.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in game development, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in game development for game developers, designers, producers, and readers tracking interactive systems.
